name: West Liberty University
academic_ranking: Oldest university in West Virginia (established 1837). Public 4-year institution accredited by the Higher Learning Commission (HLC). Enrollment approx. 2,500 students (roughly 1,900 undergraduates). Offers 70+ undergraduate majors and graduate programs across colleges of Business, Liberal & Creative Arts and Communication, Education & Human Performance, and Sciences. Noted for its comprehensive dental hygiene program, one of the earliest in the nation.
financial_aid: Out-of-state tuition & fees approx. $18,840/yr; in-state approx. $9,414/yr (2026-2027). About 36% of undergraduates are Pell grant (low-income) recipients, indicating substantial need-based aid participation. Athletic scholarships available as an NCAA D2 program (equivalency/partial scholarships permitted).
facilities_notes: Softball competes at West Liberty University; program is part of the Hilltoppers athletics department fielding 16 intercollegiate sports with nearly 400 student-athletes. Specific softball facility details not confirmed from public pages checked 2026-07.
program_reputation: NCAA Division II Mountain East Conference softball program, a charter member conference for West Liberty. Part of a long-established athletics department (Hilltoppers) at the oldest university in West Virginia.
notes: Data gathered 2026-07 from hilltoppersports.com softball coaches page, roster page, staff directory, and westliberty.edu financial-aid cost page plus Wikipedia for academic profile. Roster size (25) from softball roster page. Tuition set to out-of-state figure ($18,840) as most relevant for recruiting; in-state ($9,414) noted in financial_aid. scholarship_count not publicly listed. Head coach and assistant coach appeared on softball coaches page; staff directory listed only the two graduate assistants.
